“There you are, my dear!” You turned around to see the Queen and King approaching you. The king had a big smile on his face, while The Queen scowled in annoyance, but her face brightened up upon seeing you. 

You turned towards them, wondering what try had to say to a maid like you. “We have a gift for you, since you’ve been so loyal and good to us. We want you to come to our chambers, at midnight. Alright, dear?” The Kings words echoed throughout the halls, before you nodded with a smile. 

He smiles, before walking off further into the palace hallways with his wife, The Queen. 

You couldn’t help but wonder, what did they have in store for you at their chambers?
